published_ranges._hardness: 90A solid, down to 69A at maximum foaming
published_ranges._print_speed: up to 100 mm/s solid; about 45 mm/s at maximum foaming (reseller)
published_ranges._notes: Foaming TPU. Kexcelled's K's Lab blog says density can be adjusted from 1.14 down to 0.57 g/cm3 (unfoamed value used in fields). Print values come from an-cadsolutions.fi, which reproduces Kexcelled's print-parameter block (PEI frosted board, layer height 0.2 mm); they were seen only in a search snippet. Minimum wall 0.8 mm (reseller). AMS compatibility, drying and tolerance not published. Foaming TPU: flow ratio must be calibrated by temperature.
